label: Contractor
specifics: Cover concretely: Retention/retainage held back by the client, progress billing against completed stages, variation orders that change the contract sum, materials versus labour split, and why a signed variation must be invoiced separately from the original contract value.

label: Consultant
specifics: Cover concretely: Day rates versus hourly versus fixed-fee engagements, billing against a statement of work, expenses and disbursements billed at cost, retainers held against future work, and the difference between an invoice and a fee note.

label: Graphic designer
specifics: Cover concretely: Deposits before work starts, revision rounds and what counts as a new round, licensing and usage rights billed separately from the design fee, source-file handover as a paid deliverable, and rush fees.

label: Photographer
specifics: Cover concretely: Shoot fee versus licensing, half-day and full-day rates, second shooter and assistant costs, editing and retouching per image, travel and per diem, and image delivery tied to payment.

label: Web developer
specifics: Cover concretely: Milestone billing against a scope, hourly change requests outside scope, third-party costs passed through (hosting, domains, licences), maintenance retainers, and holding a final invoice against launch.

label: Electrician
specifics: Cover concretely: Call-out fee, labour by the hour, materials at cost plus markup, testing and certification as a line item, emergency and out-of-hours rates, and warranty terms on the invoice.

label: Plumber
specifics: Cover concretely: Call-out and minimum charge, parts versus labour, second-visit charges, emergency rates, and why a written quotation before work prevents the most common invoice dispute in this trade.

label: Cleaning service
specifics: Cover concretely: Recurring contracts billed monthly in advance versus one-off deep cleans billed on completion, per-hour versus per-visit versus per-square-metre pricing, consumables, and staffing cover charges.

label: Catering
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-head pricing with a guaranteed minimum number, deposit and final headcount deadline, staffing and equipment hire lines, cancellation terms, and service charge shown as its own line.

label: Auto repair
specifics: Cover concretely: Labour hours at a shop rate, parts with part numbers, diagnostic fee credited against the repair, the estimate-then-authorise sequence, and why the vehicle registration and mileage belong on the invoice.

label: Tutor
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-session and per-block pricing, prepaid blocks as unearned income, cancellation and no-show policy on the invoice, group versus one-to-one rates, and materials.

label: Translator
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-word, per-page and per-hour bases, source versus target word count, certified translation surcharges, minimum charges, urgency loading, and repetition discounts.

label: Event planner
specifics: Cover concretely: Planning fee versus percentage of spend, supplier costs passed through versus marked up, staged payments tied to the event date, and the final reconciliation invoice after the event.

label: Interior designer
specifics: Cover concretely: Design fee, procurement handled on the client account versus resold at a margin, site-visit charges, staged billing by design phase, and how to invoice specification work that the client then buys elsewhere.

label: Marketing agency
specifics: Cover concretely: Monthly retainers billed in advance, ad spend billed separately from management fee and why mixing them is a mistake, project fees, and out-of-scope work as an approved change.

label: Accountant or bookkeeper
specifics: Cover concretely: Fixed monthly fees for a defined scope, annual compliance work billed on filing, hourly advisory outside scope, disbursements paid on behalf of a client, and billing in the period the work relates to.

label: IT services
specifics: Cover concretely: Managed-service contracts per user or per device, hardware resold as its own line, licence renewals passed through, incident work outside contract, and project work billed at milestones.

label: Transport and logistics
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-trip, per-kilometre and per-tonne bases, waiting time and demurrage, fuel surcharge as a separate line, customs and clearing disbursements, and proof of delivery attached to the invoice.
